name: Build a persistent full-stack Kanban application
prompt: Build the Kanban application described in SPEC.md. Implement the standard-library Python package, SQLite-backed BoardStore, WSGI JSON API, optimistic concurrency with ETags and If-Match, input validation, safe static-file serving, and the responsive accessible frontend. The frontend must render with safe DOM APIs, expose loading/error/empty states, and support keyboard operation. Use parameterized SQL, add backend and JavaScript tests, run all checks, and keep the project offline-runnable with no runtime dependencies. Do not edit benchmark infrastructure.
